title: Blueberry compote with yoghurt and toasted oats

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Blueberries, honey, butter, oats, pumpkin seeds, Greek yoghurt, lemon and cinnamon are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every item is a normal Tesco line, and 400g of blueberries in July is an everyday purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small pan, a frying pan and a grater, and simmering and toasting are beginner techniques.

works.reason: 100g berries and 125g yoghurt per person with a toasted oat topping is a sensible breakfast for four, and the timings are realistic.

honest_times.reason: Zesting, toasting and assembling fit in 10 minutes, and a 5-minute simmer plus a few minutes' toasting matches the 8 minutes printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used, including lemon juice and zest and the cinnamon, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Blueberries are the main event, both warm compote and fresh, and a light fruit-and-yoghurt breakfast suits early July.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Greek yoghurt, fruit, oats and seeds make a filling breakfast with only a little honey.
